captures.name: board
captures.title: Every account you can run on
captures.body: One card per account, each showing the providers it carries. Pools sit alongside them as drop zones.

captures.name: pool
captures.title: A pool is a set of interchangeable accounts
captures.body: Launches aimed at the pool elect a member by headroom, so a spent weekly budget on one account does not stop the work.

captures.name: handle
captures.title: Drag an account into a pool
captures.body: The grip on a card lifts it; dropping it on a pool adds it to the membership.

captures.name: menu
captures.title: Or add it from the card menu
captures.body: The same membership change without a mouse drag, which is also how it is done on a phone.
